Name: Tool-Upgrade Delivery Service
Author: FelixDev
Description:
[color=#38761D]Translations currently available in: [color=#38761D]Chinese[/color], English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, [color=#38761D]Portugese, [/color]Spanish ([url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]help with the translations[/url]).[/color]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Order a tool upgrade as usual. Check your mailbox the following days for a mail sent by Clint with the tool included. You don't have to select the tool attached to the mail; you can always receive it by visiting Clint as usual. In this case, the tool won't be included in the mail.

These features are [color=#660000]disabled by default[/color] (you can enable each feature by [url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/tree/master/ToolUpgradeDeliveryService#configure]editing the config.json[/url]):
[list]
[*][b]RemoveToolDuplicates[/b] removes all tool duplicates in the player's [i]inventory[/i] when the player retrieves an upgraded tool by mail. I.e. if the player upgraded an Axe, all 'Axe' tools (copper/silver/...) will be removed.
[/list]

[url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/tree/master/ToolUpgradeDeliveryService#showcase]See the showcase page[/url] for images of the mod running in-game.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Windows/Linux (Mac likely, but not tested).
[*]Works in both single-player and multiplayer.
[*]This mod is compatible with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1307]Rented Tools[/url]. Enable the option [b]RemoveToolDuplicates[/b] so that rented tools will be removed from the inventory.
[*]This mod is compatible with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools[/url].
[*]This mod is compatible with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/605]Rush Orders[/url] (Rush Orders 1.1.4 and above).
[/list]

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Requires the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4403]FeTK[/url].
[/list]
